wiki_raw_format: Unmodified MediaWiki JSON responses and HTTP headers. Headers are stored as deterministic gzip; decompression reproduces the exact original CRLF bytes. Derived wikitext files contain each exact main-slot content string. No template expansion was used.

cache_queries.qualification: Item ID, name, stackability, inventory options and client GE flag only. No direct player-tradeability claim.
Item ID, name, stackability, inventory options and client GE flag only. No direct player-tradeability claim.

cache_decoder.qualification: The original runs did not record the loaded class origin. A later explicit 2.0.5 replay reproduces both original item-row outputs byte for byte. rev 742 is an independent dated client archive relative to Darkan/rev 727; matching decoder output is not independent player tradeability evidence.
cache_decoder.original_loaded_version: Unrecorded. The original wrapper checks that 2.0.5 exists but builds its classpath from every Gradle JAR; the retained dependency inventory does not establish the original loaded decoder.

measured_replay.version_binding: Selected dependency path and loaded ItemDefinitions class CodeSource JAR SHA-256. Package ImplementationVersion and SpecificationVersion are null.
measured_replay.historical_limit: This replay does not establish which JAR the earlier queries loaded. The original cache-input-binding record inventories an available 2.0.5 dependency, not the original loaded class.

scope: Source records only; the source-audit agent performed no product imports, product tests, data edits or MacBook calls. The driver-collected map evaluation and its source-tree binding are retained separately.

cache_input_binding.timing: Every extracted cache file was compared with its dated ZIP member after the original queries. The outputs were not rerun.
cache_input_binding.limits: The original 521-byte stdout files are unchanged and do not self-identify their input directories. Their association with each query rests on the recorded original command/cwd and output path; the later comparison binds the extracted inputs at its capture time, not retrospectively at query time.

checker_formatting.method: ast.parse and ast.dump(include_attributes=False) before and after standard-library formatting; ASTs are identical. The checker was not rerun.

header_packaging.reason: Preserve exact original CRLF, HTTP status-line trailing space and terminal blank lines through Git text normalization and whitespace checks.
header_packaging.method: gzip level 9, mtime 0; each decompressed payload was byte-compared with the original response before removing its raw file.
